sections.heading: 1. The 30-second reset
lines: ① Loading screen or respawn? Stand up.
② Look over each shoulder, slowly, 3 times.
③ Reach both arms overhead, hold 5 sec.
④ Screen at eye level, an arm's length away.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get advice if…
lines: Pain spreads into an arm or leg,
or pins and needles or numbness appear.

caption:
Gaming marathon over the weekend and your neck is paying for it? 🎮

Long sessions themselves aren't the problem. It's the hours spent frozen in one position, head drifting forward and shoulders creeping up, that tends to leave the neck and back stiff.

A few easy changes: use loading screens and respawns as cues to stand, look over each shoulder and reach overhead. Keep the screen at eye level and about an arm's length away. Balance gaming days with a walk, swim or gym session.

Pain into an arm or leg, pins and needles or numbness are worth getting checked. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio combine hands-on care with exercise. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
